$comment: Machine-readable catalogue for prototype-machine 0.6.0. Human docs: ./api.md

machine.description: A journey. One state is current; each state writes a whole tuple of context via `assign`. Use when moving one value alone would produce a state the product cannot be in.

initial.description: Starting state id. Must be a key of `states`.

states.description: `assign` is the tuple this state writes. `note` is the tooltip and is quoted in the diagram.

transitions.description: Legal moves as from -> to[]. Omit the key entirely for fully connected; supply `{a: []}` for a deliberate dead end.

param.description: Query-string key. Defaults to the id.

machine.example: journey: { label: 'Get connected', initial: 'firstRun', states: { firstRun: { assign: { step: 1, keyIssued: false } }, keyMade: { assign: { step: 2, keyIssued: true } } }, transitions: { firstRun: ['keyMade'], keyMade: ['firstRun'] } }

default.description: Required on every field. Also what a URL omits when the value matches.

hidden.description: Kept in context, URL and storage; hidden from the panel.

param.description: Query-string key. Defaults to the id.

when.description: (env) => boolean. Hides the control where it is meaningless.

boolean.example: hasEvents: { type: 'boolean', label: 'Guardrail events', default: true, trueLabel: 'Some', falseLabel: 'None' }

enum.value: literal union of the option values
enum.control: Pills, or a <select> once there are more than 6 options
enum.example: density: { type: 'enum', label: 'Density', default: 'comfortable', options: ['comfortable', 'compact'], dom: { attribute: 'data-density' } }
enum.validation: `default` must be one of `options`, or compile throws.

number.control: Number input by default; a slider with control: 'range'
number.example: seats: { type: 'number', label: 'Seats', default: 12, min: 0, max: 500 }
number.urlEncoding: decimal string; values outside min/max are dropped

date.control: datetime-local input; stored as an ISO string in UTC
date.urlEncoding: ISO string, or empty for null

derive.description: Computed from context, never stored and never in a URL. Use whenever a value follows from another rather than varying on its own.
derive.note: `ctx` contains machine cursors, assigned tuples and fields, but not other derived values.

actions.description: Buttons at the foot of the panel.
actions.example: { id: 'restart', label: 'Restart scenario', run: (api) => { api.reset(); api.navigate('/signin') } }

opensOnly: a click on the launcher button; there is no keyboard shortcut that opens the panel, and no prop to bind one

keyboard.Escape: close the diagram if open, otherwise close the panel
keyboard.arrows: nudge the panel while its handle has focus; shift for a bigger step
